assets.editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, transparent game furniture sprite. Edit only the background/transparency of the supplied ivory round pedestal coffee table. Preserve the table's exact shape, camera angle, dimensions, warm ivory color and soft material shading. Remove ALL the luminous halo, bloom, fog, shadows, blurred fringe, background and glow surrounding the table. The space outside the table must be completely transparent, including the gap beside its pedestal. The table itself must be opaque with crisp clean antialiased edges. Do not add a floor, cast shadow, glow, decorations, text or any object. Keep the entire table centered, uncropped and isolated. This is a clean alpha cutout for a game, not a luminous icon.
